value.rationale: A motivated structural exception to generic noncommuting numerical Lie splitting: exact expected Markov propagation at arbitrary steps using no more than the original two two-factor orders, a closed exact finite-h trajectory variance, and a strict minimal dimension-three obstruction. This is not a routine reparameterization or a trivial corollary of the closest inspected randomized algorithms; practical computational speed and higher-dimensional extension are not claimed.
